sql.foreach: SELECT #{record.sourceRecordKey} AS source_record_key, #{record.recordHash} AS record_hash FROM dual

mapper.update: MERGE INTO inventory_source_offline target USING () source ON (target.source_record_key = source.source_record_key AND target.is_deleted = 0) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET target.synced_record_hash = source.record_hash, target.last_sync_run_id = #{runId}, target.last_synced_at = SYSTIMESTAMP, target.updated_at = SYSTIMESTAMP WHERE target.synced_record_hash IS NULL OR target.synced_record_hash != source.record_hash

MERGE INTO inventory_source_ecommerce target USING () source ON (target.source_record_key = source.source_record_key AND target.is_deleted = 0) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET target.synced_record_hash = source.record_hash, target.last_sync_run_id = #{runId}, target.last_synced_at = SYSTIMESTAMP, target.updated_at = SYSTIMESTAMP WHERE target.synced_record_hash IS NULL OR target.synced_record_hash != source.record_hash

MERGE INTO inventory_source_greeting target USING () source ON (target.source_record_key = source.source_record_key AND target.is_deleted = 0) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET target.synced_record_hash = source.record_hash, target.last_sync_run_id = #{runId}, target.last_synced_at = SYSTIMESTAMP, target.updated_at = SYSTIMESTAMP WHERE target.synced_record_hash IS NULL OR target.synced_record_hash != source.record_hash

MERGE INTO inventory_source_warehouse target USING () source ON (target.source_record_key = source.source_record_key AND target.is_deleted = 0) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET target.synced_record_hash = source.record_hash, target.last_sync_run_id = #{runId}, target.last_synced_at = SYSTIMESTAMP, target.updated_at = SYSTIMESTAMP WHERE target.synced_record_hash IS NULL OR target.synced_record_hash != source.record_hash

UPDATE inventory_source_state st SET pending_record_count = CASE st.source_type WHEN 'OFFLINE' THEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM inventory_source_offline WHERE active_yn = 'Y' AND is_deleted = 0 AND (synced_record_hash IS NULL OR record_hash != synced_record_hash)) WHEN 'ECOMMERCE' THEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM inventory_source_ecommerce WHERE active_yn = 'Y' AND is_deleted = 0 AND (synced_record_hash IS NULL OR record_hash != synced_record_hash)) WHEN 'GREETING' THEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM inventory_source_greeting WHERE active_yn = 'Y' AND is_deleted = 0 AND (synced_record_hash IS NULL OR record_hash != synced_record_hash)) WHEN 'WAREHOUSE' THEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM inventory_source_warehouse WHERE active_yn = 'Y' AND is_deleted = 0 AND (synced_record_hash IS NULL OR record_hash != synced_record_hash)) ELSE pending_record_count END, last_success_sync_run_id = #{runId}, last_success_synced_at = SYSTIMESTAMP, updated_at = SYSTIMESTAMP WHERE st.source_type IN #{sourceType}
